files.description: Multi-point DC voltage calibration sweep, linear device (offset, gain, repeatability noise, quantisation). Test partition adds held-out interleaved and extrapolated set-points.
Multi-point DC voltage calibration sweep for a device with an explicitly modelled parabolic INL bow (justifies a polynomial-calibration comparison).
Repeated observations at a constant 5 V input for Type A repeatability evaluation.
Constant 12 V input; some runs contain a gradual sensor drift with known onset and rate, others are drift-free controls.
Stepped voltage levels with isolated outliers, an abrupt transient level shift, missing samples and invalid sensor states.
Multi-point DC current calibration sweep through a shunt model (tolerance + assumed TCR, no self-heating). Test adds held-out set-points and a held-out ambient temperature.
DC current sweep with explicitly modelled shunt self-heating (load-dependent resistance via TCR). Test adds held-out set-points and a descending sweep (different thermal history).
Random load steps between 200 mA and 2500 mA with shunt self-heating transients (load-history-dependent error).
Constant 1500 mA load; drift runs contain a gradual sensor drift with known onset and rate, others are drift-free controls.
Stepped current levels with outliers, an abrupt transient shift, missing observations, invalid sensor states and communication gaps.
Stable temperature plateaus joined by 0.1 degC/s ramps; calibration uses only the protocol-stable part of each plateau. Test adds held-out and extrapolated plateaus.
Heating and cooling ramps (25 -> 75 -> 30 degC) exposing first-order sensor lag; test uses a held-out faster ramp rate.
Stable 45 degC plateau; drift runs contain slow sensor drift (+0.5 degC/h validation, -0.8 degC/h test) with known onset; others are controls.
Abrupt true temperature changes (bath transfers, labelled as process events, not faults) with outliers, missing observations, invalid status and communication gaps.
